# superset_role (Data Source)

Data source to read an existing role in Apache Superset by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_role" "gamma" {
  name = "Gamma"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the role. If not specified, 'name' must be provided.
- `name` (String) The name of the role (e.g. 'Admin', 'Alpha', 'Gamma', 'Public'). If not specified, 'id' must be provided.
